title: Onboard loc and vendoring to code generation caching
body: As they are part of a `npx hereby generate` call. This also shares file fingerprints across all cache invocations within a `hereby` call to reduce duplicate hashing work, since the loc and vendoring tasks have a lot of input files (which, in the case of the loc task, are shared inputs with a bunch of other generate tasks) - without this, these tasks are "fast enough" that the hashing cost essentially negates the cost savings of caching. But! With it, this brings a warm `npx hereby generate` down from 10s to 4s on my laptop, which is 👌. It's still not quite "instant" (maybe I could get there with a hierarchical command cache), but it's pretty close.
